caption:
A chart drawn from the wrong column looks exactly like a chart drawn from the right one. That is what makes it expensive.

So Growth Terminal shows you which column it read, in plain English, before it draws anything.

→ growthterminal.io
first_comment: Column matching is resolved in the browser by rule. Nothing is uploaded for that step and no credit is spent.
alt_text: Poster reading: The wrong column looks exactly like the right one, above a panel showing which columns the app read.
